name: Inge, the Iron Hymn
guide_text: Use your hero for some free stats to save HP and play the game as Patchwerk 2.0.
buddy_guide_text: Buddy up for 3-5 gold, and your gameplan is around hero powering the buddy every turn. Buff it in the midgame as much as possible, using Quilboars or other single target effects.
